inputQualifications: The 1290 point proves that a healthy bosonic quadratic region exists; this audit deforms within that region to a phenomenological scale hierarchy.
The 1235 selector is accepted only as an effective conditional input. Its microscopic exchange-odd portal and Fock-space projection are not derived.

conditionalSpectrum.qualification: Zero mirrors is conditional on T_B being the exchange/conjugate presentation rather than an independent propagating module. No fermionic kinetic/Fock construction currently enforces that condition.

matchingPoint.projectorThresholdRequirement: choose the still-unspecified response Hessian so every projector tangent mass is above the matching scale; 10 TeV is an illustrative floor, not a prediction

normalization.kineticMixingQualification: chi is basis and scale dependent; matching requires a declared compact charge basis and renormalization scale
electroweakInputScheme: mZ fixes sqrt(g^2+gY^2) at tree level before the small X correction
alpha fixes the remaining electroweak combination

thresholds.control: six complex entries of the symmetric Majorana matrix and Dirac Yukawas

flavorFreedom.consequence: The displayed textures have enough coefficient freedom to fit masses and mixing, including nonzero CP, but supply no numerical flavor prediction.

exactConditional: three selected copies give the Standard Model 45 left-handed complex Weyl components
the selected module is Standard-Model anomaly free generation by generation
the full family-dependent U(1)_X assignment with three nu_R cancels all cubic and mixed anomalies
nonzero flavon expectation value supports every entry of a general Dirac matrix and a general complex symmetric Majorana matrix
matchableByParameterChoice: the electroweak scale and gauge couplings
the Higgs mass and arbitrarily small Higgs-flavon mixing
heavy vector, flavon, projector and right-handed-neutrino thresholds
all observed quark and lepton masses, mixing angles and CP phases
small renormalized hypercharge-X kinetic mixing at one chosen scale
predictions: conditional charge pattern X=B-2Y-3L_i once a family projector is supplied
a charge-three flavon and the associated split Z3 remnant
no dimensionful mass, mixing angle, Yukawa entry or collider rate

constraints.statement: The PDG 2025 Z-prime review reports that electroweak data typically constrain the kinetic and Z-Z-prime mass-mixing quantities entering Z-coupling shifts to order 1e-3.
constraints.application: The illustrative chi=1e-4 and 15 TeV vector are in a decoupling regime, but a model-specific global fit is still required.

constraints.statement: CMS EXO-25-021 reports a 95% CL lower mass limit of 5.55 TeV for the sequential-Standard-Model Z-prime benchmark using the full Run-3 dilepton data.
constraints.application: This number is not a limit on family-dependent B-3L_i. It only demonstrates that an electroweak-strength visible vector must generally be treated as multi-TeV and recast with its actual charges, branching fractions and width.

constraints.statement: ATLAS measured the 13 TeV total Higgs production cross section as 55.5 +4.0/-3.8 pb versus the Standard Model 55.6 +/-2.5 pb.
constraints.application: A singlet admixture cannot be assumed large; the illustrative scalar mixing is deliberately negligible. A combined Higgs likelihood, not this single inclusive number, is needed for a bound.

requiredRecasts: dilepton and contact-interaction likelihood using the actual family-dependent mass-basis charges
electroweak precision fit including kinetic and mass mixing
charged-lepton and neutrino flavor constraints after the Yukawa rotations are fixed
singlet-scalar searches and Higgs signal-strength likelihood
cosmology and defect constraints if the residual Z3 sector is populated

firstUnavoidableMissingDatum.name: fermionic kinetic/Fock realization of the effective selector
firstUnavoidableMissingDatum.statement: A6 needs an operator-level rule that makes exactly one of T_A and T_B the propagating chiral module, supplies Lorentz spin and Grassmann statistics, and excludes the exchange partner from the same-chirality spectrum. Document 1235 assumes this rather than deriving it.
firstUnavoidableMissingDatum.whyParameterChoiceCannotRepairIt: Changing masses, couplings or thresholds cannot decide whether an additional independent mirror Hilbert-space sector exists.
firstUnavoidableMissingDatum.minimalRepair: Construct a gauge-covariant fermionic Hilbert space and kinetic operator with the exchange-odd boundary portal, then compute its kernel/index and show that it contains three selected Standard-Model generations, three permitted singlet nu_R, and zero same-chirality mirrors.

verdict.summary: A decoupling region and complete numerical matching capacity exist conditionally, but they are fits rather than predictions and the physical chiral Hilbert space has not been constructed.
